harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (RHEL 10) via a drop-in at /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-complexity.conf enforcing minlen=12 and minclass=3. Verified enforcement functionally as a non-root user (weak passwords rejected, compliant ones accepted, boundary cases at 11 chars/3 classes and 12 chars/2 classes both correctly rejected). Performed the mandatory single-node restart via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed (d9f8550d... -> 09cf9bca...), and re-verified sshd health and password-policy enforcement (weak rejected, strong accepted) post-restart, proving persistence.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/PAM config (RHEL 10, pam_pwquality wired into system-auth/password-auth)
Created /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-complexity.conf with minlen=12, minclass=3
Verified policy with pwscore for a short password (rejected)
Created test user pwtestuser, verified weak password rejected (exit 10) and strong 12-char/3-class password accepted (exit 0) as non-root user
Verified boundary cases: 12 chars/2 classes rejected, 11 chars/3 classes rejected
Cleaned up pwtestuser
Captured baseline boot_id and sshd status
Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, acknowledgement returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed and sshd active post-restart
Confirmed policy file persisted post-restart
Re-ran functional enforcement test with new user pwtestuser2 post-restart (weak rejected, strong accepted)
Cleaned up pwtestuser2

evidence.requirement: Password policy: min 12 chars, min 3 character classes, configured on node1
evidence.summary: pwquality.conf.d/99-complexity.conf created with minlen=12/minclass=3 and confirmed present after restart

evidence.requirement: Functional enforcement pre-restart (weak rejected, compliant accepted, boundary cases)
evidence.summary: pwscore rejects short password; non-root passwd change rejects 9-char/2-class and 11-char/3-class and 12-char/2-class passwords (exit 10), accepts 12-char/3-class (exit 0)
Captured boot_id d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 and confirmed sshd active before restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot_scheduled' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node became unreachable then recovered (restart occurred)
evidence.summary: Connection timed out/reset during reboot, then exec succeeded again once node1 came back online

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service restart)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 to 09cf9bca-cc57-444e-bc05-ddeebb65ea39, and uptime -s shows a new boot time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and policy persistence
evidence.summary: sshd active and policy file content confirmed intact after restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart functional re-verification of enforced policy
evidence.summary: New test user pwtestuser2: weak password rejected (exit 10), compliant 12-char/3-class password accepted (exit 0) after restart
